easyPrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a creature you control.
description:
Activate Wall of Roots by putting two -0/-1 counters on it (due to Pir), adding {G}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
In response to Tayam's ability, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wall of Roots, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Wall of Roots from your graveyard to the battlefield with two vigilance counters on it due to Tayam and Pir.
Repeat.
